description.value:
A masterpiece of military craftsmanship — has served President Myers well for many years.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Marksman Rifle

Damage: 6d6, Drop Lowest • Capacity: 20 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Power Rebuild, Smartgun Link • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load Armor-Piercing Ammunition, which for this weapon costs the same as Basic Ammunition. Ammunition purchased for this weapon can only be used by this weapon. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (7d6, Drop Lowest). Whenever this weapon deals damage to a target’s head, the victim must succeed on a DV15 Athletics Check or else suffer a -2 penalty to their REF, DEX, and MOVE for the next 9 seconds (3 Rounds). If this decreases the target to 0 MOVE, they are then unable to take a Move Action.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Marksman Rifle
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild, Smartgun Link (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Damage is 6d6, dropping the lowest die. CPR 0.92.4 can't drop dice automatically, so drop them by hand from the damage roll.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
